title.narrative: Technical Infrastructure Services for the Rehabilitation of the UN Women Country Office in Malawi

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the project is to carry out a technical assessment and design the infrastructure for the UN Women
Malawi Country Office UNOPS will firstly provide infrastructure assessment in order to propose options for bringing the structure that is currently in a
dilapidated state, into a safe and functional office building for the UN Women Malawi. After the assessment, UNOPS will develop and
produce a detailed design of the recommended infrastructure modifications and additions that can be used by UN Women for the next course of action.
